tasks.message: I'm an engineer with no admin access. Set up Google Tag Manager, GA4, Search Console and Google Ads linking for example.com. What do we do first, and what do you need from me?

must_include: the prerequisites checklist (domain, Ads customer ID, stakeholder emails, owning Google account)
Tag Manager before GA4, GA4 through GTM rather than gtag in source
the GTM snippet handed to castform
the engineer performs each console step and reports back
must_not: prints a secret, API key or token value
claims to have signed in to or changed a Google console

tasks.message: I opened analytics.google.com and there's no Admin gear for our property, and Tag Manager says 'You don't have access to this container'. What now?

must_include: names the missing GA4 Administrator and Tag Manager Editor/Publish permissions
a ready-to-send access request with product, URL and exact role names
sign out and back in, then repeat the click path to verify
must_not: prints a secret, API key or token value
